messages.content: Hi — Northline Care check-in for the week of Sept 15. How's your blood sugar been this week? Any changes to your routine or medications?
Honestly it's been a mess. Insurance denied my test strip claim again. Third time. I'm basically flying blind half the week.

That sounds really aggravating, and I'm sorry you're in that spot. I have to be straight with you — insurance claims and appeals are outside what I'm able to help with. I can't contact your insurer or fix the denial. Your best path is calling the number on your insurance card or asking your pharmacy if there's a cash-pay option in the meantime. Were you able to get any readings at all this week?
Had a couple strips left. Checked this morning, came up 194. Been taking my glipizide every day at least.

Good that you've kept up with the glipizide — logging that. I'm also logging today's reading of 194. That's on the higher side; if you notice anything unusual — dizziness, extreme thirst, blurry vision — reach back out and we can get a nurse on it. I've also made a note in your record about the strip access problem so your care team can see it.
Feeling okay today, just frustrated. Go ahead and set my next check-in.
Done — next check-in is set for September 22, same time. Hope the strips situation gets sorted before then. Take care.

theme: insurance denied test strips or a claim question
